citations.assessment: The Ran’s citation of a Pesikta gives Yeshavav and Yehoshua of Sikhnin in Levi’s name. Vayikra Rabbah’s parallel has Mana of Sha’av instead of Yeshavav. The link identifies an attested witness to the formula and preserves the author’s search note.

notes.text: The Ran’s citation of a Pesikta gives Yeshavav and Yehoshua of Sikhnin in Levi’s name. Vayikra Rabbah’s parallel has Mana of Sha’av instead of Yeshavav. The link identifies an attested witness to the formula and preserves the author’s search note.
Retain Heilprin’s report that he did not find the name. The Ran establishes attestation in his cited wording; comparison with Vayikra Rabbah precludes harmonizing the two.
